short_caption: Single navy bed against a white wall beside a TV stand.
literal_description: View from the open doorway toward the bed wall. A single bed with a navy fitted cover and a light gray upholstered base on chrome legs runs along the white wall, with a light blue pillow at its left end. Two small posters hang above, one showing an illustrated instant camera with the word MEMENTO. A wall outlet with a plugged cable is at the left above the bed. At the right end of the bed, a small reddish-brown wooden cabinet holds a black flat-screen TV. The office chair frame is at the left edge and the open wood door is at the right edge. A loose black cable lies on the beige tile floor.
environment: Small residential bedroom, roughly 3 m by 3 m, with white painted plaster walls, beige square ceramic floor tiles with a matching tile skirting strip, an aluminum-framed casement window with a white roller shutter, and a wood-veneer interior door.
lighting: Even overhead artificial ceiling light, neutral white color temperature, low contrast, soft short shadows under furniture; no direct sunlight through the window.
atmosphere: Clear indoor air with no visible fog, smoke, dust, or haze.
ambient_sound: Quiet small-room tone with the low hum of a mini fridge compressor and a soft computer fan whir.
